spans.text: Esosof mati furimaf ufe fujuumenumi sidruwaas sati anau kankaamn waaf wajake máamak bee bukanak búrom di sísukas búrom.

Moo kaane jajak man bukanak di síkafaas kujuum mankuliŋenufo di kúyiisenufo kuñiilak ñatimkaraŋ mukaanaam moomu búrom eñesey maapi kaanimi man dúniaay búrom éyinen di ekaan siluwaas soosu nen mansiregumi eeno.

folded.id: bukanak kakinum|di|kaakemmi mofam kuwawar kupooy fiilaf falakomi fufaaraf fati kalakaak
folded.subject: Bukanak kakinum
folded.object: kaakemmi mofam kuwawar kupooy fiilaf falakomi fufaaraf fati kalakaak

spans.text: Bukanak kakinum di kaakemmi mofam kuwawar kupooy fiilaf falakomi fufaaraf fati kalakaak.

folded.id: di kairaay|di|dúniaay búrom
folded.subject: di kairaay

spans.text: Yíneni aat mati faŋaaf fati anau di sidruwaas soola, san umaje sirere di saasu ban poop sisofut di uceen soo silakom fujuumaf fati di malegenam, di kairaay di dúniaay búrom ;

folded.id: druwa káyiisen|di|bantabaay wabajimi tiribinaal yan umanje elaañut di anoosani yooyu eje'em bee efeley
folded.subject: druwa káyiisen
folded.object: bantabaay wabajimi tiribinaal yan umanje elaañut di anoosani yooyu eje'em bee efeley

spans.text: Anoosan nubabaj druwa káyiisen di bantabaay wabajimi tiribinaal yan umanje elaañut di anoosani yooyu eje'em bee efeley.

folded.id: ebaj waati|di|waati
folded.subject: ebaj waati

spans.text: Moo kaane woteey ekila ewawar ebaj waati di waati.

folded.id: ebenenbenen bapaalaab|di|mof majuupoe di tutooraay yati mof majuupoe di sisiiw sajuupoe di bukan kanaamut di uŋar di wanoosan wakaanimi man kayeraay elako di dúniaay
folded.subject: ebenenbenen bapaalaab
folded.object: mof majuupoe di tutooraay yati mof majuupoe di sisiiw sajuupoe di bukan kanaamut di uŋar di wanoosan wakaanimi man kayeraay elako di dúniaay

spans.text: Kakaraŋ kujunjuum fujuum fati epooy sidruwaas sati anau; yoo yákoney ebenenbenen bapaalaab di mof majuupoe di tutooraay yati mof majuupoe di sisiiw sajuupoe di bukan kanaamut di uŋar di wanoosan wakaanimi man kayeraay elako di dúniaay.

folded.id: ejuk yiiya|di|buŋar biiya
folded.subject: ejuk yiiya

spans.text: Anoosan wuniwun, manubaj kawonoor kiiya, ejuk yiiya di buŋar biiya, súumi jaat nuŋoolene úruuŋ mba núje'etum buŋarab biiya tíyaŋaraay nen man bucceŋum eeno.

folded.id: epoopooy anau|di|waafaw búirom
folded.subject: epoopooy anau

spans.text: Luwaay epoopooy anau di waafaw búirom.

folded.id: ésuk enampoonampoor|di|sísuk saasu man kayeraay yooyu ekila ebajo
folded.subject: ésuk enampoonampoor
folded.object: sísuk saasu man kayeraay yooyu ekila ebajo

spans.text: Kayeraay yooyu an aŋoolent ábajaatiyo; moo kaane ésukoo ésuk enampoonampoor di sísuk saasu man kayeraay yooyu ekila ebajo.

folded.id: fati anau|di|sidruwaas soola
folded.subject: fati anau

spans.text: Yíneni aat mati faŋaaf fati anau di sidruwaas soola, san umaje sirere di saasu ban poop sisofut di uceen soo silakom fujuumaf fati di malegenam, di kairaay di dúniaay búrom ;

folded.id: fool a|di|kaano nen man amaŋumi eeno
folded.subject: fool a

spans.text: Anoosan nababaj druwa ebaj fuyiifaf foola, ebaj kapooy kati faŋaaf fool a di kaano nen man amaŋumi eeno.

folded.id: furiaf wañaw|di|tan akinumi wawar jak
folded.subject: furiaf wañaw

spans.text: Anoosan nababaj druwa wákoyume bee akila, bukanak koola, furiaf wañaw di tan akinumi wawar jak.

folded.id: haani moola|di|elaañul nan súumool
folded.subject: haani moola

spans.text: Anoosan nababaj druwa épur mof haani moola di elaañul nan súumool.

folded.id: kabaji|di|kayaboore mba kayaboorut" kure'e
folded.subject: Kabaji

spans.text: Kuñiilak búrom "Kabaji di kayaboore mba kayaboorut" kure'e.

folded.id: kanoken kuñooliil|di|kakaranŋ kan koo kumanŋumi
folded.subject: kanoken kuñooliil

spans.text: Kubajaak kati kuñiilak koo koote kanoken kuñooliil di kakaranŋ kan koo kumanŋumi.

folded.id: kati siteginikas|di|kati burok kuwawar kúkambuli di bukanak búrom
folded.subject: kati siteginikas
folded.object: kati burok kuwawar kúkambuli di bukanak búrom

spans.text: Añiil nawawar akaraŋ bacaamut waafowaaf kakaraŋ kati siteginikas di kati burok kuwawar kúkambuli di bukanak búrom.

folded.id: kawonoor kiiya|di|káyiisen ko nen manumaŋumi eeno
folded.subject: kawonoor kiiya

spans.text: Anoosan nababaj druwa, ebaj kawonoor kiiya di káyiisen ko nen manumaŋumi eeno.

folded.id: kurere kererer|di|waafaw búrom
folded.subject: kurere kererer

spans.text: Bukanak búrom nan kuwolimi kurere kererer di waafaw búrom.

folded.subject: Kurere
folded.object: kayaboorak di búyebaab di ebaney yoolibo

spans.text: Kurere di kayaboorak di búyebaab di ebaney yoolibo.

folded.object: mofool di dúniaay maje'e bee ekaan man siluwaas sammi di kaytak uke siŋoolen sirok jak

spans.text: Anoosan nababaj druwa man majoone mulako di mofool di dúniaay maje'e bee ekaan man siluwaas sammi di kaytak uke siŋoolen sirok jak.

folded.id: mati kàmanjaataak|di|eñoosey sidruwaas sati anau soo siŋarulomi màkojiam
folded.subject: mati kàmanjaataak
folded.object: eñoosey sidruwaas sati anau soo siŋarulomi màkojiam

spans.text: Yíneni jaat anau nasonsoŋ mati kàmanjaataak di eñoosey sidruwaas sati anau soo siŋarulomi màkojiam, ban malegen munkul mujawulojaw di dúniaay man Anoosan muŋooleŋoolen usanken man súumimi nusof man súumimi, nupak di màkooleniam di bugaalab ;

folded.id: mba épur|di|moo
folded.subject: mba épur

spans.text: An letaŋoolen áfiren an mée ebaj mof moola mba épur di moo.

folded.id: mudeenanaam|di|kuñiilak kuwawar kubaj kákaanum di karampen káamak
folded.subject: Mudeenanaam
folded.object: kuñiilak kuwawar kubaj kákaanum di karampen káamak

spans.text: Mudeenanaam di kuñiilak kuwawar kubaj kákaanum di karampen káamak.

folded.subject: munkul mujawulojaw

folded.id: nuŋooleŋoolen ulako|di|fujuum fati mukaanaam mati mofam miiya mba nubaj kan úfojule kaje'e beet ejuumi

spans.text: Anoosan nuŋooleŋoolen ulako di fujuum fati mukaanaam mati mofam miiya mba nubaj kan úfojule kaje'e beet ejuumi.

folded.subject: nupak

spans.text: Yíneni jaat anau nasonsoŋ mati kàmanjaataak di eñoosey sidruwaas sati anau soo siŋarulomi màkojiam, ban malegen munkul mujawulojaw di dúniaay man Anoosan muŋooleŋoolen usanken man súumimi nusof man súumimi, nupak di màkooleniam di bugaalab ;

folded.id: poop búyejet|di|karampenoor
folded.subject: poop búyejet

spans.text: Kubabaj poop búyejet di karampenoor.

folded.id: poop miikeliyaay|di|kanoomen kati kumiikeel fírenifiren
folded.subject: poop miikeliyaay

spans.text: An letalako amiikeel ati akeen, letarok bee akeen; ban poop miikeliyaay di kanoomen kati kumiikeel fírenifiren.

folded.id: sàndomi soo|di|"organisation des nations unies" sijunjuum ejuum yati sidruwaas sati anau di dúniaay búrom sikaani
folded.subject: sàndomi soo
folded.object: "Organisation des Nations Unies" sijunjuum ejuum yati sidruwaas sati anau di dúniaay búrom sikaani

spans.text: Yíneni jaat mati sísukas sàndomi soo di "Organisation des Nations Unies" sijunjuum ejuum yati sidruwaas sati anau di dúniaay búrom sikaani.

folded.id: sati anau|di|faŋaaf fati anau di malegenaam mati anan di kare'enak búrom aniine di aseek ban poop kujunjuum burok man mati anau mujaw fáculey
folded.subject: sati anau
folded.object: faŋaaf fati anau di malegenaam mati anan di kare'enak búrom aniine di aseek ban poop kujunjuum burok man mati anau mujaw fáculey

spans.text: Yíneni jaat di kabaatak kati dúniaay búrom, bukanak kulanlaañ kúyiisen mankusofumi sidruwaas sati anau di faŋaaf fati anau di malegenaam mati anan di kare'enak búrom aniine di aseek ban poop kujunjuum burok man mati anau mujaw fáculey;
Nafaay yati kakaraŋak yoo eenom majakaam mati anau di faŋaaf foola.

folded.id: ubaj fujuum|di|mukaanaam mati mofam miiya
folded.subject: ubaj fujuum

spans.text: Anoosan nuŋooleŋoolen ubaj fujuum di mukaanaam mati mofam miiya.

folded.id: ulakout wátaañiye|di|luwaay di poop an letakaanool saariyoŋ yawuuje yawarin ekaani
folded.subject: ulakout wátaañiye
folded.object: luwaay di poop an letakaanool saariyoŋ yawuuje yawarin ekaani

spans.text: An leekukulool mati waaf wan umanje nan ukaanumi ulakout wátaañiye di luwaay di poop an letakaanool saariyoŋ yawuuje yawarin ekaani.

folded.id: umaje sirere|di|saasu ban poop sisofut di uceen soo silakom fujuumaf fati di malegenam
folded.subject: umaje sirere
folded.object: saasu ban poop sisofut di uceen soo silakom fujuumaf fati di malegenam

spans.text: Yíneni aat mati faŋaaf fati anau di sidruwaas soola, san umaje sirere di saasu ban poop sisofut di uceen soo silakom fujuumaf fati di malegenam, di kairaay di dúniaay búrom ;

folded.id: unoken an|di|káfa yanamaŋut
folded.subject: unoken an

spans.text: An letuŋoolen unoken an di káfa yanamaŋut.

folded.id: uwarut unoken|di|mukaanaam mati an
folded.subject: uwarut unoken

spans.text: An uwarut unoken di mukaanaam mati an, síndaay yati an, mba tan tati an mba nuyenten faŋaaf foola mba nukajen kajamaak koola.

folded.id: wan kunampoore|di|kupaalool
folded.subject: wan kunampoore

spans.text: Anoosan, nababaj druwa ebaj waaf woola fúko'ol mba wan kunampoore di kupaalool.

folded.id: yíneni jaat|di|kabaatak kati dúniaay búrom
folded.subject: Yíneni jaat

spans.text: Yíneni jaat di kabaatak kati dúniaay búrom, bukanak kulanlaañ kúyiisen mankusofumi sidruwaas sati anau di faŋaaf fati anau di malegenaam mati anan di kare'enak búrom aniine di aseek ban poop kujunjuum burok man mati anau mujaw fáculey;

folded.id: yooyuña éjowumulojowum|di|sidruwaas sati fubajaf di sati tan akinumi di sati mukaanaam moola
folded.subject: yooyuña éjowumulojowum
folded.object: sidruwaas sati fubajaf di sati tan akinumi di sati mukaanaam moola

spans.text: Kayeraay yooyuña éjowumulojowum di sidruwaas sati fubajaf di sati tan akinumi di sati mukaanaam moola.
